message.content:
**Fastest typical route (by distance & usual traffic)**  
> **New York → Boston**  
> 1. **Start** on I‑95 N (the Long Island Expressway) from Manhattan.  
> 2. Continue on I‑95 N through **Connecticut** (take the exit for I‑84 W if you want to avoid the busy I‑95 corridor in the NYC area, but most drivers stay on I‑95).  
> 3. Enter **Massachusetts** and keep on I‑95 N.  
> 4. Near **Boston**, take the exit for **I‑93 N** (or the MA‑3 N/MA‑2 N interchange) toward downtown Boston.  
> 5. Follow I‑93 N into Boston; the route ends at the **Boston‑Cambridge** area (e.g., near the **Boston‑Cambridge** tunnel or the **Boston‑Cambridge** Bridge).

- **Approximate distance:** ~215 mi (346 km)  
- **Typical travel time:** 3 h 45 min – 4 h 15 min (depending on traffic, especially in the NYC and Boston corridors).  

---

### Why this route is usually fastest

| Segment | Reason |
|---------|--------|
| **I‑95 N** | Direct northbound artery with high speed limits (up to 65 mph in many sections). |
| **I‑93 N** | The main north‑south route into Boston, bypassing the congested downtown streets. |

---

### Alternatives (if I‑95 is heavily congested)

| Alternative | Route | Approx. Time |
|-------------|-------|--------------|
| **I‑87 N → I‑90 E → I‑93 N** | Take I‑87 N from NYC to Albany, then I‑90 E (Massachusetts Turnpike) to Boston, then I‑93 N. | 4 h 30 min – 5 h |
| **I‑84 W → I‑90 E → I‑93 N** | Take I‑84 W from NYC to Hartford, then I‑90 E to Boston, then I‑93 N. | 4 h 15 min – 4 h 45 min |

These detours can be faster during peak weekday rush hours when I‑95 is clogged, but they add extra miles and may involve tolls.

---

### Quick Tips

1. **Check real‑time traffic** (Google Maps, Waze, or the state DOT traffic cams) before you leave.  
2. **Avoid peak NYC rush hour** (7–9 am & 4–6 pm) if possible.  
3. **Tolls:** I‑95 N in Connecticut and Massachusetts has tolls; the I‑90 E (Massachusetts Turnpike) is also tolled.  
4. **Weather:** Winter storms can slow traffic dramatically—plan extra time.

---

**Sample Google Maps link (replace “now” with your departure time):**  
`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/New+York,+NY/Boston,+MA/@42.3601,-71.0589,7z/data=!4m13!4m12!1m5!1m1!1s0x89c250b8b5d5f5a9:0x8c1b8e5f5b5c5d5!2m2!1d-74.0060!2d40.7128!1m5!1m1!1s0x89e3b5b5b5b5b5b5:0x5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5!2m2!1d-71.0589!2d42.3601!3e0`

*(If you click the link, it will show the current fastest route based on live traffic.)*
